topic: Video game consoles: from a simple tennis game box to a modern console (no brands)

episode.title: Evolution of Consoles: Tennis Box to Today

shots.action: Show the simple tennis-game box alone, with its two rotary knobs as the unmistakable focal feature. Sharp product detail, generous empty space.

episode.endHook: Which console era was your first?
episode.description: From a simple home tennis box to a powerful modern console, watch gaming hardware evolve through seven eras. Flash cuts, no voice—just the transformation. #EvolutionOf #GamingHistory #GameConsoles #RetroGaming #Shorts
